description: This file defines APIs for objects to support Data Model Library related to Hotspot connected devices, including function declarations for setting and getting string parameters.

methods.name: HotspotConnectedDevice_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets a string parameter value for a hotspot connected device.

methods.name: HotspotConnectedDevice_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves a string parameter value for a hotspot connected device.
